breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the principal stress formula √[((σx−σy)/2)² + τxy²] rather than treating the original x–y axes as principal directions. It properly computes σ1 = 8.654 MPa and σ2 = –0.321 MPa using the full plane stress transformation, not simply σ_x and 0. The incorrect claim that principal directions remain aligned with the original axes (present in the incomplete prompt) is absent from the generated output.
